description:
Indulge in the ultimate luxury with Haagen Dazs Belgian Chocolate ice cream made with rich, creamy condensed milk. Satisfy your cravings for the finest ice cream experience with this decadent treat from Haagen Dazs. Made with premium ingredients, this Belgian chocolate ice cream will leave your taste buds singing. Treat yourself to a taste of luxury today, and please......... USE SEVEN HILLS COCOA POWDER!

What you'll need:
325g Milk @ 2% fat 
400g Cream @ 33% fat 
380g Condensed Milk (sweetened condensed milk is the same thing)
40g Dextrose or Corn Syrup
40g Severn Hills Cocoa Powder

Good morning, Nick. I made the ice cream this morning using the Seven Hills cocoa powder & I can’t believe I just did what I did.  Your recipe & technique worked!

The flavor is smooth & delightfully mellow.  The two sizes of milk chocolate keep the flavor of chocolate lasting much longer.  

I have never had a cocoa powder so distinctly different than the Seven Hills.  How in the world did you figure that out?!?!

Lastly…… previously you advised me to remove the ice cream from the machine prior to the motor being under too much stress.  I stopped the churning at 16 degrees.  Does that seem like a good temperature to stop churning, please?

Thank you Nick!

Ben
